name: AMENDMENT_A1
reason: 2026-10-07 technical defect found in the first real control run under SCIENCE_LOCK (before any nomination, EVALUATION_LOCK or assessment). CAUSE: hcal.controls._roundtrip judged plant serialisation exactness with np.array_equal, which treats NaN != NaN; the real frozen banks carry NaN teacher means (mu) for the reserved empty tokens (registered representation), so every fresh-pipeline plant reported serialisation_exact = False and therefore every CONF / COLL / XOR common check failed although the plants were detected (common AUC_B about 0.91 on U|DIRECT-TASK and U|JOINT l0.1 s0). Synthetic test banks have no NaN. FIX: exactness is bitwise (dtype, shape and raw bytes, NaN payloads included); regression test test_amendment_a1_roundtrip_is_bitwise_with_nan_teacher_means. AFFECTED: the real-data controls only (run/controls_parts; the 2 completed parts of attempt 1 are preserved as run/controls_parts_attempt1_preA1 and the run was stopped); controls are rerun in full. UNCHANGED: every control rule, limit, plan, permutation, plant and the detection statistics; calibrate, utility, audit-plan, audit and compose outputs; all selection rules, gates, the primary family and every estimand. Substantive post-lock amendment 1 of at most 2.
